scene: A weathered paper wanted poster nailed to a harbour noticeboard, photographed straight on

subjects.description: A printed woodcut-style portrait of a young woman with long red braided hair, freckles and a green hood
Bold headline text reading "WANTED" at the top and the words "REWARD 200 CROWNS" at the bottom in a serif typeface
subjects.position: top and bottom bands of the poster

style: 19th-century letterpress poster, aged paper, ink bleed, slight tears, storyboard insert shot
lighting: soft overcast daylight from above, faint shadow of the nail head
background: grey wooden noticeboard planks, other torn notices at the edges
composition: poster fills the frame, centred, slight perspective from being pinned unevenly

camera.depth_of_field: shallow, edges of the board soft
